script.text: Yusei once again confronted his old friend Kalin to settle the score.
Good to see you, old friend!
I see that you got your Duel Runner up and running again. I was afraid that you weren’t gonna give me the opportunity to settle the score – after you sold me out.
You got it all wrong. I'm no traitor.
I have no time for your lies.
But I do have time to send you straight to the Netherworld!
I know the real you is still inside you, Kalin! It's time I get him back!
